title: How-to Guides: Writing Goal-Oriented Practical Instructions
summary: Diataxis how-to-guide principles: goal-oriented, user-perspective task instructions distinct from tutorials, focused on real-world problems rather than tool mechanics.
when-to-read: Read when writing or reviewing task-oriented instructions for users who already have basic competence and want to accomplish something specific. Do not read for teaching a skill to a beginner through guided practice (see tutorials), or for authoritative product description (see reference-guides).
